How do carbon dioxide and methane cause global warming?
A
They emit the thermal energy they have absorbed back to the Earth.
B
They absorb the radiation directly from the Sun.
C
They increase thermal energy loss to space.
D
They reduce reflection of thermal energy from the Earth’s surface.

options.label: A
options.text: They emit the thermal energy they have absorbed back to the Earth.

options.label: B
options.text: They absorb the radiation directly from the Sun.
